g.text: dFBA plate simulation (SOA): strains × carbon sources on 12 mL modified NGM + 0.4% carbon

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #555555

g.text: WT (control) re-oxidises α-KG and secretes ~0; both engineered strains clear 8 mM. The plate ENDPOINT is carbon-budget-limited, so LitOpt and the wet-lab build converge (~22-23 mM) — their design difference is the operating-point RATE (Figures 1-3). Carbon source sets the TIMING (glucose ~9-10 h, glycerol ~18-19 h: half the carbon per molecule).
